name: btc_jm_regime_moe_20260808
line: Jump-Model-gated regime MoE entry experts (5m TB labels)
reopening_argument: The regime-conditioned entry axis was closed 2026-08-08 (D2 trailing-return gate, OOS -19.5%). This line pre-registers the hypothesis that GATE QUALITY was the binding failure: the D2 gate had 9.4% trend occupancy (expert data starvation, 5-7k rows/expert) and no persistence; the causal Statistical Jump Model gate (k3, lam32/128, train-only fit, causal online decode) has 17-24% bear/bull occupancy (3-5x expert rows), median run 152-264 bars, and 66-70% zigzag-oracle agreement vs the HMM's 51%. If this line also flips OOS, the regime-conditioned entry axis on BTC is closed REGARDLESS of detector quality and must not be reopened from this panel family.

design.seed_bagging: N=5 random seeds drawn via default_rng(903174).choice(1e6), probas averaged
design.consensus_filter: pre-registered 2026-08-08 03:55 KST BEFORE any VAL result was read: additional policy axis {off, on}; on = suppress entries whose side disagrees with the concurrent czz4 wave direction (bull wave -> longs only, bear wave -> shorts only). Evaluated in a val addendum from the SAME saved seed models; same selection gates apply jointly across the full table.
controls: single LGBM + JM regime as feature (5-seed bag)

val_selection_gates: family (same gate/featset/purge, 18 rule x bear variants) >= 60% VAL-positive
oos_protocol: exactly one OOS read for the single selected config; per-seed OOS PnL reported; adoption requires OOS pnl > 0 AND >= 4/5 seeds OOS-positive AND >= 2/3 OOS months positive
multiple_comparisons_note: 72 VAL variants scored (2 gates x 2 featsets x purge x 3 bear x 6 rules); the family-robustness and per-seed gates exist to deflate single-cell cherry-picks; the single OOS read is the referee.
